text:
owen: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need concrete owners + SLAs for customer-facing comms: status page wording, the 72h technical summary, and the RCA-sharing policy. Also flag: this looks like the 3rd prefix-cache pressure incident in 6 weeks; we should mention the recurring pattern in comms and list mitigations. Proposed owners: @priya (status page), @matt (72h summary), @dina + @legal-ops (RCA policy). Pls ack and provide ETA.

priya: Ack. I can own status page copy. Draft below — short and plain. Feedback welcome.

priya: ```
We experienced increased latency and intermittent errors for a subset of requests. Service restored at 03:22 UTC.
Impact: partial degradation for impacted customers between 01:0503:22 UTC.
Cause: prefix KV cache pressure (investigation ongoing).
Next steps: were tracking this as part of a recurring cache-pressure pattern and will publish a 72-hour redacted summary with remediation actions.
```

matt: Ack. Ill draft the 72h redacted summary. Question for legal: do we include stack snippets or keep traces out?

legal-ops: Keep raw traces, tokens, internal hostnames out of public summaries. Enterprise customers may request full artifacts over secure channels per contract.

dina: Looks good. Proposed RCA policy copy for public: "A redacted RCA will be shared with impacted customers within 72 hours. Enterprise customers may request the full RCA via their account team per contractual terms."

owen: That policy copy works for me. Now timelines: status page final by EOD tomorrow (priya), 72h redacted summary by Fri 16:00 UTC (matt), RCA policy language and CSM guidance by Fri COB (dina/legal-ops). Please confirm or adjust.

priya: Ill PR status page copy by 20:00 UTC tomorrow. Will include a one-line callout about recurring cache-pressure pattern.

matt: 72h ETA OK — will submit draft by Fri 16:00 UTC and tag tech reviewers.

dina: Legal will provide the CSM guidance note by Fri COB.

owen: Action items (confirm owners):
- infra: add cache-pressure alerting + soft eviction hook (owner: matt, ETA 2w)
- runtime: review KV cache sizing & defaults (owner: rachel, ETA 1w)
- product: analyze long-prefix query patterns and recommend client-side mitigations (owner: priya, ETA 3w)
Add these to the incident tracker and link tasks here.

opsbot: Created INC-4622 "Comms follow-up + recurring cache-pressure mitigations" assigned to priya/matt/dina, due 2026-04-15. Link: https://tracker.internal/INC-4622

owen: Summary decisions: status page by EOD tomorrow (priya), 72h redacted summary by Fri 16:00 UTC (matt), redacted RCA to impacted customers; full RCA available to enterprise under contract (dina/legal-ops). Mitigation owners noted and tasks created. If you hit blockers, prefix messages with "blocker:" so we can escalate. :thumbsup:
